title: Scrolling File Tabs
description: Eight files in one CodeBlock, so the CodeBlockTabList is wider than the block. The strip scrolls sideways and fades its tabs at the ends, and with a fine pointer it shows Previous tabs and Next tabs buttons outside the tablist, which scroll it without moving the focus. A tab that the keyboard selects scrolls into view, and the copy prop of each panel names its tab. Use it for a component with many files, and File Tabs for a few files that fit.
